specs.title: HG56 S1 S2: explicit save, validation, cancel and navigation retain correct bytes
HG56 S3: integrated and protected content cannot be edited through UI or API
HG56 S1: delayed write locks fields and navigation until confirmation
HG56 S4 S5: local CAS, conflict comparison and lost response never blindly retry writes
HG56 S6 S7: agreement is bound to visible content and actual baseline diff
HG56 S8 S9: result readiness and required return explanation are checked at write time
HG56 S7: a changed visible revision cannot be agreed through an already open dialog
HG56 S8 S10: accepted result stays visible and only answered question closes
HG55 S1 S2: real catalog filters counts and empty states preserve files
HG55 S3 S4: full source operations and hostile text remain inert
HG55 S5: one actual handoff action or quiet reading
